def test_has_cycle():
    """Test the has_cycle method."""
    g = Graph()
    
    # Test empty graph
    assert g.has_cycle() == False
    
    # Test single node with no edges
    g.add_node("A")
    assert g.has_cycle() == False
    
    # Test single node with self-loop (cycle)
    g.add_edge("A", "A", 1)
    assert g.has_cycle() == True
    
    # Test two nodes with no cycle
    g2 = Graph()
    g2.add_node("A")
    g2.add_node("B")
    g2.add_edge("A", "B", 1)
    assert g2.has_cycle() == False
    
    # Test two nodes with cycle
    g3 = Graph()
    g3.add_node("A")
    g3.add_node("B")
    g3.add_edge("A", "B", 1)
    g3.add_edge("B", "A", 1)
    assert g3.has_cycle() == True
    
    # Test complex graph with cycle
    g4 = Graph()
    g4.add_node("A")
    g4.add_node("B")
    g4.add_node("C")
    g4.add_node("D")
    g4.add_edge("A", "B", 1)
    g4.add_edge("B", "C", 1)
    g4.add_edge("C", "D", 1)
    g4.add_edge("D", "A", 1)  # Creates cycle
    assert g4.has_cycle() == True
    
    # Test complex graph without cycle
    g5 = Graph()
    g5.add_node("A")
    g5.add_node("B")
    g5.add_node("C")
    g5.add_node("D")
    g5.add_edge("A", "B", 1)
    g5.add_edge("A", "C", 1)
    g5.add_edge("B", "D", 1)
    g5.add_edge("C", "D", 1)
    assert g5.has_cycle() == False

if __name__ == "__main__":
    pytest.main([__file__, "-v"])
